purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Municipal property-plan services and a city survey office are verified. Public ward-election maps are administrative boundaries, and no parcel-feature endpoint was verified.
registryAssessment: The Sangli-Miraj-Kupwad Municipal Corporation advertises property part-plan/layout information and zone-certificate services; Maharashtra Land Records lists a Sangli City Survey Office. This establishes local cadastral/property-plan activity but not anonymous downloadable parcel polygons.

officialPrimarySources.observation: The Sangli-Miraj-Kupwad Municipal Corporation advertises property part-plan/layout information and zone-certificate services; Maharashtra Land Records lists a Sangli City Survey Office. This establishes local cadastral/property-plan activity but not anonymous downloadable parcel polygons.

The official SMKC landing page labels a “भाग नकाशा” (property part-plan) and layout-information service, which appears to be a citizen service rather than a public feature dataset. Its election map page publishes ward maps only. The state land-records contact page lists the Sangli City Survey Officer. No plot/property input was submitted.
